# Genially View

> A platform for creating and sharing interactive educational presentations, gamified learning experiences, and digital content across diverse subjects.

Genially View hosts student projects, educational presentations, and interactive learning tools spanning history, music, technology, wellness, and vocational training. The platform emphasizes interactive content, gamification, and digital transformation in education with strong Spanish-language educational resources.

## Key Topics

- Interactive Content
- Educational Presentations
- Gamification
- Digital Transformation
- Escape Rooms
- Student Projects
- Screen Time Management
- Digital Wellbeing
- Ethnomusicology
- Spanish History
- Learning Technologies
- Robotics
- SWOT Analysis
- Home Automation
- Inclusive Education

## Educational & Interactive Learning

- [TECONOLOGIAS DEL APRENDIZAJE](https://view.genially.com/698a410f83e78dab7f2aa7cc/guide-teconologias-del-aprendizaje): Guide on learning technologies and digital transformation in pandemic education
- [RENACIMIENTO Y BARROCO](https://view.genially.com/698a3946d64d470bc94fb750/interactive-content-renacimiento-y-barroco): Interactive presentation on Renaissance and Baroque art history in Europe
- [Revolució Francesa](https://view.genially.com/6988a4f6aefbd6241452aa87/presentation-revolucio-francesa): Interactive history presentation on French Revolution and Enlightenment
- [Usos y funciones de la música](https://view.genially.com/698a434ca5b4f763e7775bb1/presentation-usos-y-funciones-de-la-musica): Educational presentation on music functions and ethnomusicology theory
- [Diego Fernández de Huete](https://view.genially.com/69592fa871a2d1841c1e9915/presentation-diego-fernandez-de-huete): Educational presentation on 17th-century Spanish baroque harp musician
- [Hardware y Software](https://view.genially.com/6989ec6b69f2154784a3258d/presentation-hardware-y-software): Educational presentation on hardware and software fundamentals
- [esquema de guiones](https://view.genially.com/6985bf10efa25853b0d3a4c4/presentation-esquema-de-guiones): Robotics introduction guide covering robot types and classification

## Gamified & Interactive Experiences

- [SalvemosDiwali](https://view.genially.com/698a1760aeb7f1269a826963/interactive-content-salvemosdiwali): Interactive Diwali-themed breakout escape room game for learning
- [Escape room](https://view.genially.com/698a4be25467c6d257ee3448/presentation-escape-room): Medical training escape room on sterilization protocols and equipment
- [JUEGO DE MESA EMOCIONES](https://view.genially.com/698a3c8c28b902d581d3a9f3/interactive-content-juego-de-mesa-emociones): Interactive emotional intelligence board game for inclusive education
- [Quiz](https://view.genially.com/698a5f38d2986f9923c106e6/interactive-content-quiz): Interactive quiz template gallery with assessment and gamification tools
- [Bad bunny](https://view.genially.com/698a534383e78dab7f33c97b/interactive-content-bad-bunny): Interactive music activity with Bad Bunny song lyrics fill-in-blanks
- [3 añosGenially_copy - MATCH THE COLOUR](https://view.genially.com/698a623cd64d470bc96326ca/presentation-3-anosgeniallycopy-match-the-colour): Early childhood interactive color matching learning activity

## Technical & Professional Development

- [Frigate y Prowlarr](https://view.genially.com/698a501328b902d581de5352/presentation-frigate-y-prowlarr): Technical guide on Frigate and Prowlarr home automation setup
- [Análisis DAFO](https://view.genially.com/698a64ce767f44a29c6e352e/interactive-content-analisis-dafo): SWOT analysis guide for renewable energy vocational training curriculum
- [registrarse myclassgame GRUPO 5 2026](https://view.genially.com/698a5ba4d64d470bc960df24/interactive-content-registrarse-myclassgame-grupo-5-2026): Student onboarding guide for myclassgame classroom gamification setup

## Student Projects & Creative Works

- [Habilitando herramientas de bienestar digital en nuestro móvil](https://view.genially.com/698a411528b902d581d65876/presentation-habilitando-herramientas-de-bienestar-digital-en-nuestro-movil): Student project on digital wellbeing tools for mobile screen time management
- [TRIANGULATED STRUCTURE](https://view.genially.com/698a554ef9079c5572ae6f62/interactive-content-triangulated-structure): Educational workshop on structural engineering and load testing design
- [Title 1](https://view.genially.com/698a3ab6aeb7f1269a9c71fb/interactive-content-jaime-armenteros-conde): Student art project analyzing Matisse's La Danza painting interactively
- [Isla](https://view.genially.com/698a495eb4c40c0023bc85ff/interactive-content-isla): Interactive template showcase with drag-and-drop corporate training content
